## [CN]结论
## [EN]Verdict

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| **七条决策全部落实**，没有偏离。总体评分 **82 / 100**：兼容性与健壮性达标；扩展性、依赖反转与解耦有明确的短板，根源是同一个：**页面查找是 `CYLTabBarController.m` 里的静态 C 函数，只在 `-initWithConfiguration:` 中运行一次**。它依赖具体类 `CYLTabBarPageRegistry`（`isKindOfClass:` 检查），查找顺序写死，注册表与解析回调不被控制器保留，因此初始化之后无法再次解析页面（远程配置更新、`-reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes:`、登录后换 Tab），也无法被单元测试直接覆盖。 | **All seven decisions are implemented**, with no deviation. Overall score **82 / 100**: compatibility and robustness are where they should be; extensibility, dependency inversion and decoupling have a clear weak spot with one root cause: **page lookup is a static C function inside `CYLTabBarController.m`, run once in `-initWithConfiguration:`**. It depends on the concrete class `CYLTabBarPageRegistry` (an `isKindOfClass:` check), the lookup order is hard-coded, and the controller keeps neither the registry nor the resolver, so pages cannot be resolved again after initialization (a remote configuration update, `-reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes:`, a different set of tabs after login), nor covered directly by unit tests. |

| 维度 Dimension | 分数 Score | 一句话 / In one line |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 兼容性 Compatibility | 18 / 20 | 现有 API 未动，新键均为新增；Swift 示例尚未使用注册表 / No existing API changed, every key is new; no Swift example uses the registry yet |
| 健壮性 Robustness | 18 / 20 | 异常、错误返回值、重复页面、线程均有防护；类扫描只做一次，之后加载的镜像不会被发现 / Exceptions, bad results, duplicate pages and threads are guarded; the class scan runs once, images loaded later are never seen |
| 扩展性 Extensibility | 15 / 20 | 提供者只能同步返回；没有“跳过了哪些 Tab”的回调；初始化后不能再解析 / Providers are synchronous only; no callback for skipped tabs; no resolution after init |
| 依赖反转 Dependency inversion | 15 / 20 | 控制器依赖具体注册表类与 dyld 扫描，而不是一个“页面来源”协议 / The controller depends on the concrete registry class and on the dyld scan, not on a "page source" protocol |
| 解耦 Decoupling | 16 / 20 | 查找逻辑、顺序与校验都在控制器内；提供者拿到的是整个属性字典 / Lookup, order and validation live in the controller; providers receive the whole attribute dictionary |

## [CN]逐条核对最初的决策
## [EN]The original decisions, one by one

| 决策 Decision | 实现 Implementation | 状态 Status |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 1. 方案 C（注册工厂）+ 可选 D（解析回调），不要 F / C (registered factories) + optional D (resolver), no F | `CYLTabBarPageRegistry`（ID → `CYLTabBarPageProvider` block）；`CYLTabBarControllerPageResolver` block；没有对象字典键 / `CYLTabBarPageRegistry` (ID → `CYLTabBarPageProvider` block); the `CYLTabBarControllerPageResolver` block; no object-dictionary key | ✅ |
| 2. 专用的 `CYLTabBarItemPageIdentifier`，缺省或为空时取 `CYLTabBarItemIdentifier` / A dedicated `CYLTabBarItemPageIdentifier`, falling back to `CYLTabBarItemIdentifier` | `CYLPageIdentifierOfTab()`：先 PageIdentifier，空白视为未设置，再 Identifier / `CYLPageIdentifierOfTab()`: PageIdentifier first, blank counts as unset, then Identifier | ✅ |
| 3. 删除类名键 / Remove the class-name keys | 代码、17 个示例文件、.proto、导出脚本与文档中均已删除；边界情况 C1–C5 标记为移除 / Removed from the code, the 17 sample files, the .proto, the export script and the docs; edge cases C1–C5 marked removed | ✅ |
| 4. 全局 + 每个 TabBar 一份，多 TabBar 演示 / Global + per tab bar, a multi-tab-bar demo | `+sharedRegistry` 与实例；`CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry` 键；演示 `cyl_presentTwoTabBarsDemo` 用同一 ID 映射不同页面 / `+sharedRegistry` and instances; the `CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry` key; the `cyl_presentTwoTabBarsDemo` demo maps one ID to different pages | ✅ |
| 5. 先找 PageIdentifier，自动注册，都没有再跳过 / PageIdentifier first, automatic registration, else skip | 顺序：实例注册表 → 解析回调 → 全局注册表 → `CYLTabBarPage` 类（扫描 App 镜像）→ 跳过并在 DEBUG 下警告 / Order: instance registry → resolver → shared registry → `CYLTabBarPage` classes (scan of the app's images) → skip with a DEBUG warning | ✅ |
| 6. 远程兼容字段 / Remote compatibility keys | `CYLTabBarItemPlatforms`、`CYLTabBarItemMinimumAppVersion`（数值比较）、`CYLTabBarItemPageParameters`；Protobuf 字段 33–36 / `CYLTabBarItemPlatforms`, `CYLTabBarItemMinimumAppVersion` (numeric comparison), `CYLTabBarItemPageParameters`; Protobuf fields 33–36 | ✅ |
| 7. Android 演示 / Android demo | `Example-Android/tabpages`（纯 Kotlin 注册表、`ServiceLoader` 自动注册、同一份 JSON）+ 两个 TabBar 的 App / `Example-Android/tabpages` (a pure Kotlin registry, `ServiceLoader` auto-registration, the same JSON) + an app with two tab bars | ✅ 仅 JSON / JSON only |

## [CN]各方面的发现
## [EN]Findings by dimension

### [CN]兼容性（18 / 20）
### [EN]Compatibility (18 / 20)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| ✅ 四个现有初始化方法都转调 `-initWithConfiguration:`，行为不变；旧项目不传配置字典就完全不经过注册表。 | ✅ The four existing initializers call `-initWithConfiguration:`; behavior is unchanged, and a project that passes no configuration dictionary never touches the registry. |
| ✅ 协议方法命名为 `cylTabBarPageIdentifier` / `cylTabBarPageWithAttributes:`（无下划线），Swift 可直接实现；`sharedRegistry` 导出为 `shared`。 | ✅ The protocol methods are `cylTabBarPageIdentifier` / `cylTabBarPageWithAttributes:` (no underscore), so Swift implements them directly; `sharedRegistry` is exported as `shared`. |
| ✅ 配置文件中未知键只警告不报错，旧文件加新键、新文件给旧版本都能读。 | ✅ Unknown keys in a file only warn, so old files with new keys and new files on old versions both load. |
| ⚠️ 没有任何 Swift 示例工程使用注册表或 `CYLTabBarPage`，Swift 侧的 API 形状（`register(_:forPageIdentifier:)`、协议的 `static` 要求）只在文档里，CI 没有编译过。 | ⚠️ No Swift example project uses the registry or `CYLTabBarPage`; the Swift shape of the API (`register(_:forPageIdentifier:)`, the protocol's `static` requirements) exists only in the docs and has never been compiled by CI. |
| ⚠️ Android 只读 JSON，iOS 读 12 种格式。共用“一份配置”在实践中意味着共用 JSON。 | ⚠️ Android reads JSON only, iOS reads 12 formats. Sharing "one configuration" means sharing JSON in practice. |

### [CN]健壮性（18 / 20）
### [EN]Robustness (18 / 20)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| ✅ 提供者抛出的异常被捕获（C12）；返回值若不是控制器、是 TabBarController、已有父容器或已被其他 Tab 使用则拒绝（C13）；注册表用 `@synchronized`；空白 ID 视为未设置；两个类争用一个 ID 时按类名取第一个并警告。 | ✅ Exceptions from providers are caught (C12); a result that is not a view controller, is a tab bar controller, already has a parent or is used by another tab is refused (C13); the registry uses `@synchronized`; blank IDs count as unset; two classes claiming one ID keep the first by name, with a warning. |
| ✅ 平台 / 版本排除后，代码传入的子控制器按下标同步移除（B22）；#774 之后 slot 也先移除（B26）。 | ✅ After platform / version exclusion the view controllers from code are removed by index too (B22); since #774 the slot is removed first as well (B26). |
| ⚠️ `automaticallyRegisteredPageClasses` 用 `dispatch_once` 只扫描一次。之后才加载的镜像（按需加载的动态框架、插件、`dlopen`）里的 `CYLTabBarPage` 类永远找不到，而且没有刷新接口。 | ⚠️ `automaticallyRegisteredPageClasses` scans once under `dispatch_once`. A `CYLTabBarPage` class in an image loaded later (an on-demand dynamic framework, a plugin, `dlopen`) is never found, and there is no way to rescan. |
| ⚠️ 扫描遍历 App 全部非系统镜像的所有类（`objc_copyClassNamesForImage`），在首次创建 TabBar 时于主线程进行。大型 App（数万个类、几十个动态库）会在启动路径上付出一次可感知的代价，且无法关闭。 | ⚠️ The scan walks every class of every non-system image (`objc_copyClassNamesForImage`), on the main thread, when the first tab bar is created. A large app (tens of thousands of classes, dozens of dynamic libraries) pays a noticeable one-time cost on its startup path, and cannot turn it off. |
| ⚠️ 被跳过的 Tab 只在 DEBUG 下打日志，Release 中静默消失；App 无法得知哪些 Tab 没有页面、为什么。 | ⚠️ A skipped tab is only logged in DEBUG and disappears silently in Release; the app cannot learn which tabs had no page, or why. |

### [CN]扩展性（15 / 20）
### [EN]Extensibility (15 / 20)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| ✅ 注册表是独立的类，可以创建多份；解析回调可接入任何路由 / DI 容器；`CYLTabBarItemPageParameters` 把参数传给页面。 | ✅ The registry is a separate class and can be instantiated freely; the resolver can bridge any router / DI container; `CYLTabBarItemPageParameters` passes parameters to the page. |
| ❌ **只在初始化时解析一次。** 控制器不保留 `CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry` 与 `CYLTabBarControllerPageResolver`，`-reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes:` 也不会按页面 ID 创建页面。远程配置更新、登录后换 Tab、A/B 测试切换 Tab，都必须重新创建整个 TabBarController。 | ❌ **Resolved once, at initialization.** The controller keeps neither `CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry` nor `CYLTabBarControllerPageResolver`, and `-reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes:` does not create pages from page IDs. A remote configuration update, a different set of tabs after login, or an A/B switch of tabs all require a new tab bar controller. |
| ❌ 提供者必须同步返回页面。懒加载的模块（先显示占位，模块下载 / 初始化完成后替换）无法表达。 | ❌ A provider must return the page synchronously. A lazily loaded module (show a placeholder, replace it once the module is downloaded / initialized) cannot be expressed. |
| ⚠️ 查找顺序固定（实例 → 回调 → 全局 → 自动）。想让自动注册的类优先于全局注册（例如测试替身）或者关闭自动注册，都做不到。 | ⚠️ The lookup order is fixed (instance → resolver → shared → automatic). Preferring auto-registered classes over the shared registry (e.g. test doubles), or turning automatic registration off, is impossible. |
| ⚠️ PlusButton 仍只能通过 `context` 选择（见 [PlusButton 注册调研](PlusButton-Registration-Research.md)），等待决策。 | ⚠️ The PlusButton can still only be chosen through the `context` (see the [PlusButton registration research](PlusButton-Registration-Research.md)); awaiting a decision. |

### [CN]依赖反转（15 / 20）
### [EN]Dependency inversion (15 / 20)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| ✅ 页面不依赖 TabBarController：`CYLTabBarPage` 只要求一个 ID 与可选的工厂方法；提供者 block 不引用库内类型（除 UIKit）。方向正确。 | ✅ Pages do not depend on the tab bar controller: `CYLTabBarPage` asks for an ID and an optional factory; provider blocks reference no library type (beyond UIKit). The direction is right. |
| ❌ 反过来，控制器依赖**具体类**：`#import "CYLTabBarPageRegistry.h"`，并用 `isKindOfClass:[CYLTabBarPageRegistry class]` 校验配置值。App 自己的路由器、DI 容器或 Mock 不能作为“注册表”传入，只能绕道解析回调。 | ❌ The other way round, the controller depends on a **concrete class**: it imports `CYLTabBarPageRegistry.h` and validates the configuration value with `isKindOfClass:[CYLTabBarPageRegistry class]`. An app's own router, DI container or mock cannot be passed as "the registry"; it must take the detour through the resolver. |
| ❌ 自动注册把 `mach-o/dyld` 与 `objc/runtime` 的扫描放进了核心库，控制器因此依赖“进程里有哪些类”这一运行时事实，而不是依赖一个抽象的“页面来源”。 | ❌ Automatic registration puts a `mach-o/dyld` + `objc/runtime` scan into the core library, so the controller depends on the runtime fact "which classes exist in the process" rather than on an abstract "page source". |
| ⚠️ Android 侧 `TabPageRegistry<P>` 是泛型、`TabItem` 是类型化的；iOS 侧提供者收到 `NSDictionary`。两端对“页面来源”的抽象程度不一致。 | ⚠️ On Android `TabPageRegistry<P>` is generic and `TabItem` is typed; on iOS a provider receives an `NSDictionary`. The two sides abstract "a page source" to different degrees. |

### [CN]解耦（16 / 20）
### [EN]Decoupling (16 / 20)

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| ✅ 解析（`CYLTabBarController+CYLConfiguration`）、规范化、排除（平台 / 版本）、页面查找、TabBar 组装分层清楚；配置文件不含任何 iOS 类名。 | ✅ Parsing (`CYLTabBarController+CYLConfiguration`), normalization, exclusion (platform / version), page lookup and tab bar assembly are clearly layered; a configuration file contains no iOS class name. |
| ❌ `CYLPageIdentifierOfTab` / `CYLCallPageProvider` / `CYLPageProviderOfClass` / `CYLPagesOfTabs` 是 `CYLTabBarController.m` 里的静态函数（该文件已超过 8000 行）。查找规则与控制器绑死，既不能单独测试，也不能被其他入口（例如一个 `UITabBarController` 子类之外的容器）复用。 | ❌ `CYLPageIdentifierOfTab` / `CYLCallPageProvider` / `CYLPageProviderOfClass` / `CYLPagesOfTabs` are static functions in `CYLTabBarController.m` (a file past 8000 lines). The lookup rules are tied to the controller: they cannot be tested on their own, nor reused by another entry point (e.g. a container that is not this `UITabBarController` subclass). |
| ⚠️ 提供者拿到的 `tabAttributes` 是整个规范化字典，包括私有标记键（`_CYLTabBarItemExcluded`、slot 标记）与所有外观键。契约过宽，库内任何键的改动都可能影响 App 代码。 | ⚠️ The `tabAttributes` a provider receives is the whole normalized dictionary, private marker keys (`_CYLTabBarItemExcluded`, the slot marker) and every appearance key included. The contract is too wide: any key change inside the library can reach app code. |
| ⚠️ `CYLPagesOfTabs` 顺手设置页面的 `navigationItem.title`，这是控制器对页面内容的一次写入。合理但应当文档化并可关闭。 | ⚠️ `CYLPagesOfTabs` also sets the page's `navigationItem.title`, a write from the controller into page content. Reasonable, but it should be documented and switchable. |

## [CN]改进建议（按优先级）
## [EN]Suggestions (by priority)

| 优先级 Priority | 建议 Suggestion | 解决什么 / What it fixes |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **P0** | **抽出页面解析器。** 新增 `CYLTabBarPageResolver`（或放在 `CYLTabBarPageRegistry` 的一个类方法里）：输入 Tab 属性数组、实例注册表、回调，输出 `(pages, keptItems, skipped)`。`-initWithConfiguration:` 只调用它。 / **Extract the page resolver.** A `CYLTabBarPageResolver` (or one class method on `CYLTabBarPageRegistry`): tabs in, instance registry and resolver in, `(pages, keptItems, skipped)` out. `-initWithConfiguration:` only calls it. | 解耦、可测试、可复用 / decoupling, testability, reuse |
| **P0** | **控制器保留页面来源。** 新增只读属性 `cyl_pageRegistry`、`cyl_pageResolver`（初始化时从配置取），并让 `-reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes:` 对没有子控制器的新 Tab 按页面 ID 创建页面。 / **The controller keeps its page sources.** Read-only `cyl_pageRegistry` and `cyl_pageResolver` (taken from the configuration), and `-reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes:` creates pages from page IDs for new tabs without a view controller. | 远程更新、登录换 Tab / remote updates, tabs after login |
| **P0** | **为注册表与解析器写 XCTest。** master 已有 `CYLTabBarControllerTests` 目标（#773）；新增 `CYLTabBarPageRegistryTests.m`：查找顺序、空白 ID、重复页面、异常提供者、排除规则、B26。 / **XCTests for the registry and the resolver.** master now has the `CYLTabBarControllerTests` target (#773); add `CYLTabBarPageRegistryTests.m`: lookup order, blank IDs, duplicate pages, throwing providers, exclusion rules, B26. | 目前只有 Linux 上的解析器测试 / today only the parser is tested, on Linux |
| **P1** | **依赖协议而不是类。** 新增 `@protocol CYLTabBarPageProviding` { `-pageProviderForPageIdentifier:` }，`CYLTabBarPageRegistry` 遵守它；`CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry` 接受任何遵守者（`conformsToProtocol:` 代替 `isKindOfClass:`）。 / **Depend on a protocol, not a class.** A `CYLTabBarPageProviding` protocol { `-pageProviderForPageIdentifier:` } that `CYLTabBarPageRegistry` adopts; `CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry` accepts any conformer (`conformsToProtocol:` instead of `isKindOfClass:`). | 依赖反转；App 的路由器 / Mock 可直接传入 / dependency inversion; an app's router / mock plugs in directly |
| **P1** | **自动注册可控。** 配置键 `CYLTabBarControllerAutomaticPageRegistration`（默认 YES）；`+[CYLTabBarPageRegistry registerPageClass:]` 供显式登记；`+rescanPageClasses` 供动态加载后刷新；扫描结果改为按 ID 懒查询或放到后台线程预热。 / **Automatic registration under control.** A `CYLTabBarControllerAutomaticPageRegistration` key (default YES); `+[CYLTabBarPageRegistry registerPageClass:]` for explicit registration; `+rescanPageClasses` after dynamic loading; the scan result looked up lazily per ID or warmed on a background thread. | 启动成本、晚加载的镜像 / startup cost, late-loaded images |
| **P1** | **报告被跳过的 Tab。** 新增 `CYLTabBarControllerDelegate` 可选方法 `tabBarController:didSkipTabWithAttributes:reason:`（或控制器上的 `cyl_skippedTabs` 数组，元素含 ID、标题、原因枚举：无 ID / 未注册 / 被排除 / 提供者失败）。Release 下也可观测。 / **Report skipped tabs.** An optional `CYLTabBarControllerDelegate` method `tabBarController:didSkipTabWithAttributes:reason:` (or a `cyl_skippedTabs` array on the controller with ID, title and a reason enum: no ID / unregistered / excluded / provider failed). Observable in Release too. | 健壮性、可诊断 / robustness, diagnosability |
| **P1** | **收窄提供者的契约。** 给提供者一个只读的 `CYLTabBarPageRequest`（`pageIdentifier`、`tabIdentifier`、`title`、`parameters`、`tabBarController`），而不是整个字典；现有 `CYLTabBarPageProvider` 保留，新增 `CYLTabBarPageFactory` 类型并优先调用。 / **Narrow the provider contract.** Give providers a read-only `CYLTabBarPageRequest` (`pageIdentifier`, `tabIdentifier`, `title`, `parameters`, `tabBarController`) instead of the whole dictionary; keep `CYLTabBarPageProvider`, add a `CYLTabBarPageFactory` type and prefer it. | 解耦；与 Android 的 `TabItem` 对齐 / decoupling; parity with Android's `TabItem` |
| **P2** | **异步页面。** 提供者可返回 `CYLTabBarPagePlaceholder`（或 `-registerAsyncPageProvider:` 接收 completion），模块就绪后由控制器替换该下标的子控制器（需要新增一个原地替换的方法）。 / **Asynchronous pages.** A provider may return a `CYLTabBarPagePlaceholder` (or `-registerAsyncPageProvider:` with a completion), and the controller replaces the view controller at that index once the module is ready (a new in-place replacement method is needed). | 懒加载模块 / lazily loaded modules |
| **P2** | **Swift 示例。** 在 `Example-Swift-SwiftManager` 中用 `CYLTabBarPageRegistry.shared.register(...)` 与一个 `CYLTabBarPage` 类，让 CI 编译 Swift 侧 API。 / **A Swift example.** Use `CYLTabBarPageRegistry.shared.register(...)` and one `CYLTabBarPage` class in `Example-Swift-SwiftManager`, so CI compiles the Swift side of the API. | 兼容性验证 / compatibility proof |
| **P2** | **Android 读更多格式**（至少 YAML / plist 之一）或在文档中明确“跨端共享的是 JSON”。 / **More formats on Android** (at least one of YAML / plist), or state in the docs that JSON is the shared format. | 两端对等 / parity |
| **P2** | **可配置的查找顺序**：`CYLTabBarControllerPageLookupOrder`（数组，默认 `[instance, resolver, shared, automatic]`）。 / **A configurable lookup order**: `CYLTabBarControllerPageLookupOrder` (an array, default `[instance, resolver, shared, automatic]`). | 测试替身、关闭自动注册 / test doubles, turning automatic registration off |

### [CN]P0 的 API 草图
### [EN]API sketch for P0

```objc
/// [EN] The outcome of resolving one tab. [CN] 一个 Tab 的解析结果。
typedef NS_ENUM(NSInteger, CYLTabBarPageSkipReason) {
    CYLTabBarPageSkipReasonNone = 0,
    CYLTabBarPageSkipReasonMissingIdentifier,   // no page ID / 没有页面 ID
    CYLTabBarPageSkipReasonUnregistered,        // nothing registered for the ID / ID 未注册
    CYLTabBarPageSkipReasonExcluded,            // platforms / minimum version / 平台或最低版本
    CYLTabBarPageSkipReasonProviderFailed,      // nil, exception or refused result / nil、异常或被拒绝的返回值
};

@protocol CYLTabBarPageProviding <NSObject>
- (nullable CYLTabBarPageProvider)pageProviderForPageIdentifier:(NSString *)pageIdentifier;
@end

@interface CYLTabBarPageRegistry (Resolving) <CYLTabBarPageProviding>
/// [EN] Resolves the pages of `tabs` with the documented order; `skipped` lists the tabs without a page and why.
/// [CN] 按文档中的顺序解析 `tabs` 的页面；`skipped` 列出没有页面的 Tab 及原因。
+ (NSArray<UIViewController *> *)pagesOfTabs:(NSArray<NSDictionary *> *)tabs
                                    registry:(nullable id<CYLTabBarPageProviding>)registry
                                    resolver:(nullable CYLTabBarPageProvider)resolver
                                   keptTabs:(NSMutableArray<NSDictionary *> *)keptTabs
                                    skipped:(nullable NSMutableArray<CYLTabBarSkippedTab *> *)skipped;
@end

@interface CYLTabBarController (CYLPageRegistry)
@property (nonatomic, strong, readonly, nullable) id<CYLTabBarPageProviding> cyl_pageRegistry;
@property (nonatomic, copy, readonly, nullable) CYLTabBarPageProvider cyl_pageResolver;
@property (nonatomic, copy, readonly) NSArray<CYLTabBarSkippedTab *> *cyl_skippedTabs;
@end
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 全部为新增 API；`CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry` 键继续接受 `CYLTabBarPageRegistry` 实例（它遵守新协议），不破坏已有调用。 | All of it is new API; the `CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry` key keeps accepting a `CYLTabBarPageRegistry` instance (it adopts the new protocol), so existing calls do not break. |

## [CN]需要你决定的问题
## [EN]Questions for you to decide

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 1. 是否按 P0 抽出解析器并让控制器保留页面来源？（建议：是，这是其余建议的基础。） | 1. Extract the resolver and keep the page sources on the controller, as in P0? (Proposed: yes; the other suggestions build on it.) |
| 2. `CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry` 是否改为接受协议 `CYLTabBarPageProviding`？（建议：是。） | 2. Should `CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry` accept the `CYLTabBarPageProviding` protocol? (Proposed: yes.) |
| 3. 自动注册：保留“默认开启、可关闭”，还是改为“默认关闭、显式开启”？（建议：默认开启，加开关与 `+rescanPageClasses`。） | 3. Automatic registration: keep "on by default, can be turned off", or "off by default, opt in"? (Proposed: on by default, with a switch and `+rescanPageClasses`.) |
| 4. 被跳过的 Tab 用代理方法还是只读数组报告？（建议：两者都有，数组为主。） | 4. Report skipped tabs through a delegate method or a read-only array? (Proposed: both, the array first.) |
| 5. 提供者的新契约 `CYLTabBarPageRequest` 现在做，还是等 PlusButton 注册一起设计？ | 5. Design the `CYLTabBarPageRequest` contract now, or together with PlusButton registration? |
| 6. 异步页面（P2）是否列入本 PR，还是另开 issue？（建议：另开。） | 6. Asynchronous pages (P2) in this PR, or a separate issue? (Proposed: separate.) |
